correctness.rationale: All possible image subalgebras of the semisimple diagonal F_q^2 are 0, two idempotent coordinate lines, the diagonal line and the whole plane. Their lifts yield the Z,T,L,K types, with explicit q[d]_q codimension-one cover multiplicities; the recurrences z_d=f_d, t_d=(d+1)f_d, ell_d=[d+1]_q f_d and c_d=2ell_d+t_d+q[d]_q c_(d-1) give the stated formula, including m=0 count 3. Before the first quotient drop, q^(m-j)f_m/f_j full-quotient continuations and 2ell_j+t_j lower choices give exact J_m law. After q^-m normalization each summand is 2q/(q-1)+summable O_q((j+1)q^-j); TV O_q(1/m) follows. Independent direct F2 m1 enumeration checked 13 subalgebras and 14 chains.
